properties.statement:
REFLOW2 CAN ALREADY JUDGE TEST QUALITY STRUCTURALLY, ON THREE AXES, AND TWO OF THEM HAVE NEVER BEEN USED. Measured 2026-08-11 while asking where the line falls between test quality reflow2 can check and test quality only a person can judge.

THE LINE IS FURTHER OUT THAN IT LOOKED. The claim under test was that a test's quality is textual — valid, isolated, repeatable, focused, fast, covers edge cases and error conditions — and therefore out of reach for a deterministic core (`req:deterministic-core`). That is only partly true, and the interesting part is which half.

MEASURED:

  Verifications                                                  137
  targets per check          1 -> 130    2 -> 6    3 -> 1
  ⇒ FOCUS is already good here. 130 of 137 check exactly one thing, so a
    focus detector modelled on granularity_report would find nothing on this
    design. A useful NEGATIVE result: the metric exists and the problem does not.

  THE THREE BUILT EVIDENCE-QUALITY AXES, IN USE:
    TIME   (how old the check is)             99 of 137 carry last_run_at
    INPUT  (what it PINNED vs SWEPT)          0 VERIFIES edges carry a scope
    INDEP  (was the value fitted to it)       0 CALIBRATED_AGAINST edges

  detectors mentioning scope, narrowness or circularity           0
  surface for the two unused axes    evidence_report, confirmation_ledger
                                     — read-only, and you must know to call them

⭐ SO THE EDGE-CASE QUESTION IS ALREADY ANSWERABLE STRUCTURALLY. `set_evidence_scope` records what a check PINNED versus SWEPT, and `evidence_report` reads it: "a parameter every passing check pins is reported as NARROW; ONE check that sweeps it ends the narrowness." That is a machine-checkable proxy for "does the suite explore the boundaries" — exactly one of the eight criteria that looked textual. `req:evidence-says-what-it-covered` is ACCEPTED. The machinery is 3 functions, 643 lines of test, 18 cases, mutation-checked on all three axes.

⚠️⚠️ AND IT IS THE CONTENT STORE'S PROFILE EXACTLY. `dec:the-content-store-is-discontinued` (accepted, 2026-08-09) reads: "built, shipped, correct, and used zero times in every project that has it." Two of these three axes are in that same state today. The parallel is not loose — both had an accepted requirement behind them, both were carefully built, both were tested well, and neither was ever reached for.

📌 THE FORK THIS OPENS, and it is real rather than rhetorical:
  (a) MAKE THEM ASKED-FOR. A detector — "this passing check does not say what it covered" — would surface the axes at the moment a check is recorded. Cheap, and it is the fourth instance today of the same diagnosis: the capability exists and nothing asks for it.
  (b) DISCONTINUE THEM, on the test that killed the content store. There is now a mechanism for exactly that, shipped hours ago: an accepted Decision OBSOLETES what it withdrew, and four computations read it.
  (c) NEITHER YET — zero usage on ONE design is thin evidence, and this design is the author's own. A consumer project's suite is where narrowness would actually bite.

⭐⭐ WHAT THIS MEANS FOR THE PHILOSOPHY QUESTION IT IS FILED AGAINST. `dec:idea-verification-is-planned-with-the-requirement` proposes that reflow2 guide a project to plan verification when a need is stated. This measurement is a warning about HOW: reflow2 has already built test-quality machinery once and nobody used it, because nothing asked. Adding requirement-side planning WITHOUT asking would repeat that exactly — and would be the fifth instance today of a capability that exists and never fires.

WHAT REMAINS GENUINELY TEXTUAL, and is not claimed to be checkable: VALID (does it measure what it claims, or a side effect), HAPPY PATH and ERROR CONDITIONS coverage, and whether a test reads the CONTRACT or the IMPLEMENTATION — that last being `dec:bl-185`, still open. ISOLATED, REPEATABLE and FAST are not textual but are simply ABSENT: the graph records no run history (one `last_run_at`, overwritten), no duration, and no dependency between checks, so a proxy for them would need new data rather than a new reading.
